about_the_game:
This game is designed with only the roulette wheel function. It does not include betting features or additional rules, focusing purely on simulating the operation of a roulette wheel in a simple design. It supports both the American and European types.​

By default, the game allows a limited number of spins per session. You can restart the app to continue enjoying the experience. For those who prefer unlimited spins without restarting, an optional DLC ("Roulette Wheel Full Version") is available to remove this limitation.​

  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 (2020) or later (Intel Macs are not supported)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
